title: TNT Rebalanced Recipe
description: Simply alters the crafting recipe of TNT to be a little cheaper.
body:
TNT now costs 2 gunpowder and 2 paper. ![The new recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c83ae7b2bed7054596ac4d9343dd240b73a5b431.png)

This is a datapack so all you have to do is put it in the datapacks folder for a specific world.
